I'm a senior lecturer
at the 
[Department of Multilingualism and Foreign Language Education](https://www.unifr.ch/pluriling/en/) 
at the University of Fribourg in Switzerland,
where I teach courses on second and foreign language learning
as well as on quantitative methodology and statistics.
I also assist researchers with research design, data analysis, and 
the interpretation of empirical findings.

In my spare time, I enjoy exploring the Swiss countryside,
and I play the saxophone and occasionally write songs for 
[Beat Moustache](https://beatmoustache.ch), 
a ska-pop band that mostly plays original songs in the Bernese dialect.
